chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen's Desperate Escape from the Tyrant Dragon on Dragon Island
chapter_meta_description: Gravely wounded and hunted by an ancient Tyrant Dragon, Xiao Chen is rescued by a brave Celestial Horse. He recovers and uncovers the mystery of Dragon Island's seal.
og_title: Escape from the Tyrant Dragon – Xiao Chen's Perilous Flight
og_description: Injured and alone, Xiao Chen faces the terrifying Tyrant Dragon. But a tiny Celestial Horse risks its life to save him...
twitter_title: Xiao Chen's Narrow Escape from a Dragon's Jaws
twitter_description: A brave Little Celestial Horse lures away a rampaging Tyrant Dragon to save Xiao Chen. Healing and mystery await in this thrilling chapter.
